notes.title: Rusty Lake: Roots is 66% OFF in our Rusty Lake Anniversary Steam Sale! 🎊
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009977/85101fe90af9f7530ffd1c19793018841c016d64.jpg

Happy 10 years of Rusty Lake! 🥳 And what better way to celebrate a decade of Rusty Lake than with:


 A new free-to-play game: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show - hat tricks, sleight of hand, and a few unexpected reveals you don’t want to miss; 
 An early look at our upcoming premium Rusty Lake game
 And special Rusty Lake anniversary merch in collaboration with Lost in Cult - available to pre-order right now;
 A week-long platform-wide discounts of up to 66% OFF on all our premium games, including hosting our very own Rusty Lake Anniversary Steam Sale Page

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26608424/0506a0d718efeb80a6099b5136e5f7897e9a9acf.png

Of course, the sale includes Rusty Lake: Roots, which you can now download and play for 66% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/532110/Rusty_Lake_Roots/

And don't forget to check out our new magical puzzle game: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show. A free-to-play short but magical game filled with enough secrets and unexpected twists to put you in a celebratory mood!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472550/The_Mr_Rabbit_Magic_Show/

Keep an eye out for secrets while playing The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show, and you might just find an early look at our next Rusty Lake adventure! Wishlist now to stay up to date!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26608424/79fc9db394a84f82d17eecccf67771e750806427.png

As a special thank-you for your continued support over the past 10 years, we’re excited to further delight you with some special Rusty Lake anniversary merch in collaboration with Lost in Cult available to pre-order as of today, April 30th:


 🎵 Rusty Lake: Sounds of the Lake 10th Anniversary Vinyl Collection - 20 of Rusty Lake’s Greatest Hits performed by Victor Butzelaar. 
 🃏 A mysterious deck of cards (perfect for your own magic tricks) - designed by Maarten Pelders, inspired by the series’ surreal symbols and characters.
 📖 A re-launch of our fan-favourite Paradox Comic Book by Lau Kwong Shing 

Whether you’ve been a part of our Rusty Lake universe since the first launch of a Cube Escape title back in 2015, or you’ve joined our journey during our later years, we’d like to share a heartfelt Thank you! from the whole Rusty Lake team!
 
Thanks to you and your incredible support, we’ve had an amazing 10 years, and we’re as excited as ever to continue exploring the mysteries of Rusty Lake with more video games, short films, tablet-top experiences and much more! We hope you’ll stick around for what’s to come!

The past is never dead.

notes.title: Rusty Lake: Roots is Now 44% OFF | More updates from The Lake
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26608424/0fde4d536e93153a464c15727bcfc02b6c910ee0.png

Hey everyone! All our premium games, including Rusty Lake Roots, are now on sale in the SteamSummerSale for 44% OFF!  And to make the summer sale even better, our Rusty Lake Bundle is 52% OFF!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/532110/Rusty_Lake_Roots/

And with the sale, we bring forth some insights into our plans at Rusty Lake:

Physical Escape Room

Lately, we have been very busy with our first physical escape room: Rusty Lake’s Black Cube Exhibition which went live during TwitchCon Rotterdam. The experience turned out to be a huge success, so we hope to bring it to other future conventions, if possible.  Read more on our blog!

Rusty Lake Untold

For the past 2 years, we’ve also been working on our first pen & paper, tabletop, escape room: Rusty Lake Untold. We are thrilled to release our first adventure: The Lab for free later this month: on July 24! Make sure to sign up here and read how to play.

Follow the meaning

We are also collaborating with Hiking Mind studio to release their debut title Follow the meaning through our publishing platform: Second Maze. The game is a premium point-and-click adventure with beautiful graphics and playtime of around 1.5 hours. They aim to release in Q3 and we think a lot of people who enjoy Rusty Lake will also enjoy this adventure so make sure to wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720280/Follow_the_meaning/  

Of course, we are also working on new game projects, but unfortunately, we cannot share anything about those plans just yet!

Stay tuned!

PS. All our Second Maze games are also 44% OFF in the Steam Summer Sale!

notes.title: Rusty Lake Roots is 50% OFF in Steam Puzzle Fest 🌸 New Game Announced 🚇
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26608424/022411e618fc25f537d007b20e851ca43a3072f5.png

This week marks 8 years together as Rusty Lake! And, of course, we have to celebrate this incredible anniversary with several announcements, including a big reveal.

A part of our anniversary celebrations is being part of Steam Puzzle Fest! You can now grab Rusty Lake Roots, as well as all our other Rusty Lake premium titles, for 50% OFF from today until May 1st!

New Game in the Rusty Lake universe

[previewyoutube=7I8eBrH7Azk;full][/previewyoutube]
📣 Next stop in the Rusty Lake universe: Underground Blossom! 🚇 🌸

We’re happy to finally share a first look at our upcoming project, Underground Blossom! Descend into the Rusty Lake Underground and travel through the life and memories of Laura Vanderboom! 

All aboard the Underground Blossom Demo - now available to play on Steam! Don’t forget to wishlist Underground Blossom to secure a ticket! 🎟️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291850/Underground_Blossom/

The full experience will arrive later this year on mobile (iOS / Android) and PC! 🛤️

notes.title: The Past Within + Rusty Lake Midweek Madness
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce our upcoming title The Past Within:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515210/The_Past_Within/ 

Are you ready to unlock The Past Within? Teaming up with a friend, travel through both past and future to piece together the mysteries surrounding Albert Vanderboom. Communicate what you see around you to help one another solve various puzzles and explore the worlds from different perspectives!

Official teaser trailer:

[previewyoutube=bopzNbExy1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

The Past Within is an upcoming multiplayer point-and-click adventure taking place in the Rusty Lake universe. Next to PC & Mac, the game is also coming to IOS, Android and hopefully console!

Please keep in mind that the development of this game is still in an early stage: we still have a long way to go before we can communicate a release date! Stay tuned on our social media, our blog or on Steam for more information / development logs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623373/7eb60367c1a92592a8c6307e44c5802491354ec5.png

Together with this big announcement and the 5 year anniversary of our first premium game released on Steam, Rusty Lake: Hotel, we’d like to celebrate alongside all of you with a 50% discount on all of our Steam games! Thank you for all your love and support, we wouldn’t be here without all of you wishlisting, reviewing and sharing your enthusiasm for our games on Steam!

Thank you all for your support, stay safe and greetings from The Lake!

notes.title: The Cube Escape Collection is now available! 🎉
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33593611/cf0f6f168ff467c1a553bc23068435a1e744ffc6.jpg

Hi everyone!

We’re very excited to finally release a Collection of the first nine Cube Escape chapters on Steam to survive the end of the Flash Games era:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection/

We hope you will be happy to finally have all these games in one place where you can easily revisit the Rusty Lake universe and unlock all the 72 new achievements! There is also a new hint system and our translators did a tremendous job adding translations to all of them.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UTKfF1K1MUg

We are celebrating this much-awaited release with a sale, as a small thank you to all of you for the amazing support you’ve shown us over the years. When we released our first Cube Escape game, Seasons, 5 years ago we never dreamed we would attract such an amazing community. To this day we’re still blown away by your continuous support and kind words. Thank you for being such a big part of the Rusty Lake journey!

Good luck finding all the achievements and please stay tuned for future Rusty Lake updates!

Thanks for your support! The past is never dead 🦐

Rusty Lake

Important:
- We really appreciate your feedback! Feel free to leave a review in the store!
- Any bugs/glitches? Please let us know on Discord or at support@rustylake.com.
- All our games (including The White Door) are on 50% sale as well for today - please keep an eye on our Steam page!
- The Collection contains 9 chapters: Seasons, The Lake, Arles, Harvey's Box, Case 23, The Mill, Birthday, Theatre and The Cave. Paradox will be available separately.
- These games do not contain any new content from their original versions (besides achievements, a new hint system and translations)!

notes.title: Rusty Lake: Roots Achievements are now available and more news!
notes.content:
Achievements 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26608424/9118668e76fa676378a757c102f9f6c4f8c7de64.png

We're very happy to announce that we finally got the long-awaited Steam achievements working for Rusty Lake: Roots. We choose a total of 16 different achievements for you to unlock. Downside is that we are a bit afraid that your progress will be lost when you update the game; this happened before with previous updates and we don't have a solution for this yet. 
Sorry you guys needed to wait so long for us to add the Steam achievements... It was a big technical challenge for both the Windows and Mac version. We hope it all works now correctly, if you encounter any issue, please email us at info@rustylake.com

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26608424/186c70a635491b47734fadabb3f3b47ec775d7c8.png

 The Cave and a new Premium project 

Next to this we are continuously working on new content. At te end of March we launched a new free game in the series: 
Cube Escape: The Cave. It has a lot of connections with Roots and you can find out more what is happening in Rusty Lake. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26608424/153d3ab2b0f464ca1852114fcc86b1d5b2ac1e9a.png

We are now working on a bigger premium game again, which we are very excited about, stay tuned for updates on our blog.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26608424/d2ac932a1d1119ba0a002057bec6c735a2febf62.png

Rusty Lake Hotel & Roots Bundle 

We also made a bundle available for both Rusty Lake Hotel and Rusty Lake: Roots, if don't have both games you can buy them now as a bundle with a 15% discount. 

Store languages 

Not but not least we added 14 languages for the store, if you see an error in your language, please let us know :) 

Thanks for your support !!
